recentItems.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as President and CEO. What You Need to Know - November 23
recentItems.description:
Jay O'Brien has the latest on Jensen Huang being reinstated as President and CEO of Nvidia, less than two weeks after his resignation. Plus, the Delta outage that triggered nationwide delays for passengers traveling during the holidays, the Amtrak train crash that injured five people, flu cases are beginning to rise ahead of Thanksgiving, and singer and actor Donny Osmond helped extinguish a neighbor's fire while in his
church suit, along with other headlines you need to know today.

00:25: JENSEN HUANG REINSTATED: Nvidia has announced Jensen Huang has been reinstated as CEO.
01:57: DELTA OUTAGE : A technical outage disrupted holiday travel for passengers.
02:31: RUSSIAN SHIP/LIBYA: An attack on a Russian navy ship is raising concern that the war with Ukraine may be expanding.
02:58: EL-SAYED/JD VANCE: Aides to Vice President JD Vance and Michigan Senator elect Abdul El-Sayed say they're working to arrange a meeting.
04:11: AMTRAK TRAIN CRASH: At least five people are hurt after an Amtrak train slammed into a semi-truck.
04:32: THANKSGIVING FLU: Flu cases are rising as Thanksgiving rolls around.
04:58: SKUBAL DEAL: Tarik Skubal has agreed to a record $450 million nine-year contract with the New York Mets.
05:20: DONNY OSMOND GRILL FIRE: Former teen idol Donny Osmond put out his neighbor's grill fire in his church suit.
05:43: FIRST GEN-Z SAINT: A young girl has taken the first step toward possible sainthood six years after her death.

--

recentItems.title: Public health concerns over lead detonation in Iowa
recentItems.description:

ABC News' Dr. Darien Sutton has more details.
